newsitem.title: UK: European jet prices stay weak in thin demand.
newsitem.headline: European jet prices stay weak in thin demand.

text.p: European jet fuel prices remained depressed on Tuesday. Traders said that buying interest was very thin and avails in both NWE and the Mediterranean were good.
Benchmark gas oil futures continued to hover above support at $160 and jet barge and cargo differentials held steady as sellers eyed the $1.50 contango to July on gas oil.
"Sellers are looking to price cargoes against the July (gas oil) screen but what few buyers there are want and will probably end up getting June related oil," one broker said.
Good avails were seen out of the UK in NWE and Egyptian, Italian and Libyan barrels were seen available in the Med.
Fob barge and cif cargo premiums were notionally valued around June IPE +$17 a tonne.
